text_ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ خِدَاشٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ بَهْزِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ
سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِنَّكُمْ وَفَّيْتُمْ سَبْعِينَ أُمَّةً أَنْتُمْ خَيْرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا عَلَى اللَّهِ
text_ar_search:
حدثنا محمد بن خالد بن خداش حدثنا إسمعيل ابن علية عن بهز بن حكيم عن أبيه عن جده قال
سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول إنكم وفيتم سبعين أمة أنتم خيرها وأكرمها على الله
text_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the following Verse: 'It is He Who has sent down to you (Muhammad) the Book (this Qur'an). In it are verses that are entirely clear, they are the foundations of the Book; and others not entirely clear (up to His saying: ) 'And none receive admonition except men of understanding.' Then he said: 'O 'Aishah, if you see those who dispute concerning it (the Qur'an), they are those whom Allah has referred to here, so beware of them.'"
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Muhammad bin Khalid bin Khidasy] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Isma'il bin 'Ulayyah] dari [Bahz bin Hakim] dari [ayahnya] dari [Kakeknya] dia berkata; saya mendengar Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Sesungguhnya kalian telah menyempurnakan tujuh puluh ummat, dan kalian adalah yang terbaik dan yang paling mulian di antara mereka di sisi Allah."
